expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Deadline for timed challenges; null otherwise.

mistake_limit.title: Mistake Limit
mistake_limit.description: Mistakes allowed in a challenge; null otherwise.

mistakes_remaining.title: Mistakes Remaining
mistakes_remaining.description: Challenges only; null in standard lessons.

submission_id.title: Submission Id
submission_id.description: Client-generated id (e.g. UUID). Retrying with the same id is safe.

heart_lost.title: Heart Lost
heart_lost.description: Whether this answer cost a heart.

correct_answer.title: Correct Answer
correct_answer.description: Revealed only after the answer has been checked.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description: Structured correct answer, for highlighting in the UI.

note.title: Note
note.description: Soft feedback, e.g. an accent reminder.

unlocked_skill_id.title: Unlocked Skill Id
unlocked_skill_id.description: Skill unlocked by this completion, if any.

CompleteLessonOut.title: CompleteLessonOut
CompleteLessonOut.description: Result of a completion. Repeating the request returns the same body.

CurrentUserOut.title: CurrentUserOut
CurrentUserOut.description: Identity plus everything the top stats bar needs, in one request.

text.title: Text
text.description: In the language being learned; this is what audio speaks.

language.title: Language
language.description: BCP-47 code of the entries' language.

term_heading.title: Term Heading
term_heading.description: Heading of the tip table's first column.

translation_heading.title: Translation Heading
translation_heading.description: Heading of the tip table's second column.

highlights.title: Highlights
highlights.description: Words to accent in the tip's text; empty: default.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Closing paragraph, after the tip's table.

layout.title: Layout
layout.description: Order of a tip's parts: table/note/examples, examples/note/table or table/examples/note.

next_heart_at.title: Next Heart At
next_heart_at.description: When the next heart regenerates; null if full.

LessonOut.title: LessonOut
LessonOut.description: Everything needed to render a lesson — and nothing that reveals an answer.

purchase_id.title: Purchase Id
purchase_id.description: Client-generated id (UUID). A retry with the same id never charges twice.

replayed.title: Replayed
replayed.description: True when this purchase_id had already been processed.

token.title: Token
token.description: Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request.

owned.title: Owned
owned.description: Inventory count for items you keep; null otherwise.

unavailable_reason.title: Unavailable Reason
unavailable_reason.description: Why it can't be bought right now.

email.title: Email
email.description: Becomes the sign-in name; stored lower-case.

practiced_days.title: Practiced Days
practiced_days.description: Days in the month with a completed lesson.

freeze_days.title: Freeze Days
freeze_days.description: Days in the month covered by a streak freeze.

current.title: Current
current.description: Displayed streak (0 once a day has been missed).

active_today.title: Active Today
active_today.description: Whether a lesson was completed today.

UnitChestOut.title: UnitChestOut
UnitChestOut.description: Treasure chest at the end of a unit: claimable once every skill is completed.
